metric_type_note: canonical_screen_bt (contract build_benchmark_compare, NW lag-3). NOT forge build_bt_result (that is authoritative for capital admission). Screening/mechanism-location grade.

universe.label: KOSPI200_KOSDAQ150_intersection
universe.note: NGBoost forecasts all 3345 factor-DB tickers; SELECTION restricted to in-universe (K200 U KQ150) via inner-join. First-pass measurement bug (87.7% non-universe rows return-zeroed) caught in reconciliation and corrected.

period.note: Forecasts start 2010-02 (60-month min expanding-train window from 2005-01 factor panel).

base_composite.description: KNOWN-GOOD base = EW cross-sectional aligned-Z composite of 14 validated KR factors (quality/momentum/value/low-risk/liquidity). Distinct from prior weak-base uncertainty attempts (lottery/fscore+momentum).
base_composite.verdict: Base is genuinely known-good: strong positive rank-IC BOTH periods (full t=6.3, post2017 t=4.87). The transfer-wall question is meaningful precisely because cross-sectional IC is strong.

forecast_uncertainty_method.outputs: per-stock mu_hat (mean forecast = Arm A alpha) + sigma_hat (predictive SD = forecast uncertainty)
forecast_uncertainty_method.pit: Strict expanding: month t model trained only on rows month<=t-2 (forward label fully realized before t). No look-ahead (C1/C7). Label winsorized 1/99 train-only.
forecast_uncertainty_method.sigma_hat_is_forecast_uncertainty_not_re: sigma_hat is NGBoost predictive SD per stock (forecast confidence), NOT a return covariance Sigma. Role boundary respected: no Sigma / weights produced.

mechanism_check.verdict: Mechanism WORKS as designed: Arm B systematically selects lower-forecast-uncertainty names (0.109 vs 0.127). But armB mean fwd ret 0.0118 <= armA 0.0125 -> lower sigma did not buy higher realized return.

transfer_wall_diagnosis.rank_ic_vs_port_t: NGBoost mu_hat in-univ rank-IC full t=3.38 / post2017 t=2.47 (positive, significant), yet top-25 long-only PORT_t is ~0 (full) and -1.4 (post2017). Textbook IC->PORT_t transfer failure.

quintile_monotonicity.note: Non-monotonic. Top quintile only marginally beats bottom; ordering power in the top/long region is weak and noisy.

top_half_ic.note: rank-IC restricted to top-half (long-only relevant region) is insignificant (t=1.89) vs full-universe t=3.38 -> the IC is carried largely by the short-side/bottom which long-only cannot harvest.

gross_vs_net.note: Even GROSS (pre-cost) top-25 active t<1 (0.66). Turnover 14x/yr x 15bps ~2.2%/yr further erodes. Edge is null before costs even matter.

verdict.rationale: (1) Uncertainty conditioning worked mechanically (Arm B tilted to low-sigma) but produced NO significant PORT_t improvement (full dSR -0.048 t=-0.42; post2017 dSR +0.029 t=+0.45 -- both insignificant, opposite signs). (2) The binding constraint is not high-uncertainty over-selection: even top-half rank-IC is insignificant (t=1.89) and GROSS top-25 active t=0.66. The forecast has strong FULL-universe IC (short-side driven) but no long-only top-region ordering edge. sigma_hat is not the axis where the signal dies.
verdict.honest_negative: Valuable negative per AX-000: the wall's nature is regularity-of-decay in the long-region + short-side-carried IC, generalizing measurement-graduation section6 'orthogonal != profit' / 'IC != PORT_t' to the uncertainty-conditioning lever. Uncertainty selection is not a transfer-wall lever for KR long-only.

graduation_gate_check.conclusion: FAILS graduation HARD (PORT_t>=2.95) by a wide margin in both arms/periods. No capital path. screen_route = NOT even OVERLAY_CANDIDATE (no residual long edge).
